translations.text: And I said, “O Lord, my Lord, have I come into the world for this—to see my mother’s suffering? No, my Lord!”
And where is everything you said to Moses about us?
Go, then, and do as I command you.
And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them.
And [?] took me to the place where I had stood before.
Blessed is the one who was not born, or the one who was born and died.

I will call the sirens from the sea. And you, night demons, come from the desert, and you, demons and jackals, from the forests. Wake up and gird your waists for dancing. Take up lamentations with me and dance with me.

But you, priests, take the keys of the sanctuary and throw them to the heights of heaven. Give them to the Lord and say, “Guard your house yourself, for look, we have been found to be dishonest stewards.”

And you, virgins who spin fine linen and silk with gold from Ophir, hurry, take everything, and throw it into the fire, so that it may carry them to the one who made them, and the flame may send them to the one who created them, so that enemies will not gain possession of them.
For truly, in its time, wrath will rise against you—the wrath that is now held back by patience, as though by reins.
For what benefit is there in this? Or what worse things than these events we see happening are we waiting to see?

What did those who had knowledge in your presence gain, who did not follow emptiness like the rest of the nations and did not say to the dead, “Give us life,” but always feared you and did not abandon your ways?
And now I see that the world that was made for our sake still remains, while we, for whose sake it came into being, are passing away.
For now it is the end of time—or of affairs, or of prosperity, or of dishonor—that must be considered, and not its beginning.
Therefore, look, days are coming when times will hasten more than the former ones, seasons will run faster than those that have passed, and years will pass more swiftly than the present ones.
Go, then, and sanctify yourself for seven days. Do not eat bread or drink water, and do not speak to anyone.
Or nothing? For we are not now as we were formerly, and we will not remain afterward as we are now.
For just as I have not forgotten human beings, those who remain and those who have passed away, so I remember those who are remembered and those who are coming.
And you must also hear what is to come after these times.

For some of them leave out some of what belongs to them and take from others, and some complete both what belongs to them and what belongs to others, so that those who are on earth will not understand in those days of the end of times.
But whoever understands then will become wise.
And after what is to happen in these divisions has been completed, then the Messiah will begin to be revealed.

You exercised power over what was not yours, and you never even had compassion on what was yours. You extended your dominion over those far from you, and you caught those who came near you in the traps of your wickedness. You always exalted yourself as though you could not be uprooted.

Go, then, you too, cedar, after the forest that went before you. Become dust with it, and let your dust mingle together. Sleep now in distress and rest in torment until your final time comes, when you will return again and be tormented still more.
And he answered and said to me, “Baruch, this is the interpretation of the vision you saw.”

And when the time approaches for it to come to its end and fall, then the dominion of my Messiah will be revealed, which is like the spring and the vine. When it is revealed, it will uproot the multitude of its army.
For destruction takes those who belong to it, and life takes those who belong to it.

For you have gone from this place, and you are passing from the regions that are now visible to you. You have forgotten what is perishable, and you no longer remember the things that exist among mortals.
You remember the beginning you made, and you do not forget the destruction that is to come.
And that time of distress will arise. For it will come and pass with a fierce rush, and it will be turbulent as it comes in furious anger.
For they will see that world which is not visible to them now, and they will see the time that is now hidden from them.
Take pleasure in the suffering you now endure. For why do you look to the downfall of your enemies?

For at the very beginning they were very dark for a time. Afterward I saw that the waters were bright, but they were not abundant. After these I again saw dark waters, and after these bright waters again, then dark waters again, then bright waters again.
And after these things I saw, and behold, twelve streams were rising from the sea. They surrounded that lightning and were subject to it.
And those who did not love your law perish justly, and the torment of judgment awaits those who did not submit to your dominion.
And all the wicked deeds committed by the kings who came after him.
For the last waters you saw, which were darker than all those before them—the ones that came after the twelve and were gathered together—belong to the whole world.
For, concerning the evils of the wicked who were to come before him, he foresaw their conduct [?].
But all those who ruled over you or knew you—all these will be handed over to the sword.
And no one will again die before his time, nor will any adversity occur suddenly.
Or who can recount the thoughts of your mind?
For the one you serve is merciful, and the one in whom you place your hope is compassionate, and he is faithful to do good and not harm.
If, then, you look to the law and are attentive to wisdom, the lamp will not be lacking, the shepherd will not depart, and the spring will not dry up.
